touchdown_contact_state_definition.footprint: actual printed upright M8 tip face AF4.8 regular hexagon
touchdown_contact_state_definition.support_surface: head OD disk minus the AF8.1 mouth
touchdown_contact_state_definition.area_method: deterministic convex polygon clipping; head circle uses a 720-edge inscribed polygon

cone_command_geometry.semantics: conservative drawing bound only; quantitative diagnostics use conv(xy(Rz(-phi) Ry(15deg) Rz(phi) [AF4.8@z0, AF6@z1])) at every phase and are not touchdown-state labels
cone_command_geometry.phase_grid: 360 uniform samples on [0,360deg), matching the recorded phase-bin contract
cone_command_geometry.diagnostic_area_normalization: mouth intersection area divided by that phase's projected printed-frustum convex-hull area

sampling_design.sentinel_semantics: exact repeats of one supported and one landing-mouth-clear outer-partial clean point
sampling_design.boundary_quarantine_semantics: two supported/double and two double/outer near-boundary diagnostics

true_label_rule: measured_touchdown_run_local_XY_to_operator_taught_M8_center; preregistered CAD local offsets define targets and labels
